$schema_note: Machine-readable icon inventory, as of 2026-07-29, covering BOTH icon systems in console/. 'icons' below is the 48 custom inline-SVG components (source console/app/components/icons/*.hbs) with the 'svg' field as a STATIC, cleaned version of the real .hbs template: Ember expressions ({{or @class "..."}}, ...attributes) are resolved to their DEFAULT literal values so the markup renders as-is in a plain HTML/React context. 'fontAwesome' below is the OTHER, dominant icon system (<FaIcon @icon="name">, 225 files, ~150 distinct names) — corrected in this pass after an earlier version wrongly called it vestigial (it had only grepped the lowercase 'fa-icon' helper, missing the actual <FaIcon> component). Source of truth for any future change remains the .hbs files, not this JSON.

fontAwesome.note: Shapes are not committed to this repo — they come from the free-solid-svg-icons package at runtime. A reference site cannot render these from repo files alone; it needs the FontAwesome package (or an equivalent set) as a dependency.

otherNavigationIcons.fleetops-switcher: dynamic: arrow-right / arrow-left depending on switch direction
otherNavigationIcons.iam-switcher: dynamic: arrow-right / arrow-left depending on switch direction

hardcodedColors.note: 7 icons hardcode a hex stroke color instead of using currentColor, so they do NOT adapt to dark mode or to a consumer's text color the way the other 38 do. Flagged as an inconsistency, not a deliberate two-tier icon system.

duplicateGeometry.note: Two pairs of icons share identical path data under different names — likely accidental duplication rather than intentional aliasing.

parametric.note: sort-arrow-down is not a static icon — it renders dynamic text labels and colors via @topLabel/@bottomLabel/@topColor/@bottomColor/@arrowColor args. The 'svg' entry below shows it with its default args (A/Z sort indicator).
